# SIMD-0674 validator location registration

The `instr/*.fix` files are protosol instruction fixtures generated by Agave's
conformance harness. They cover registration, V4 conversion and shrinking,
updates of V5 accounts, voter purging, trailing instruction bytes, feature gates,
error precedence, legacy accounts, conversion limits, and malformed V5 fields.

Regenerate from the repository root:

```sh
EMIT_CONFORMANCE_FIXTURES="$PWD/svm/tests/fixtures/validator-location" \
  cargo test -p solana-svm --lib \
  --features agave-unstable-api,conformance \
  validator_location_registration_conformance
```

Replay the committed fixtures:

```sh
cargo test -p solana-svm --lib \
  --features agave-unstable-api,conformance \
  validator_location_registration_fixtures_replay
```

The runtime test `test_validator_location_registration_epoch_boundary` submits
signed registration transactions, activates enforcement across an epoch boundary,
and checks stake exclusion and retention of previously captured locations.

## Activation dependencies

The feature IDs in this implementation are provisional. Replace them with the
assigned feature keys and regenerate these fixtures before network activation.
The SDK dependency is pinned to PR #1059 at
`a0d12066a505ca9c453a584518db3b34af898bd5`.

SIMD-0701 also requires upgrading the Stake program to accept V5 vote accounts
when `validator_location_registration` activates. The upgrade hook is pending a
V5-capable Stake program build, upgrade buffer, and artifact hash. This change
does not supply that external program release. A full local-cluster ledger run
must use that upgraded Stake program; the epoch-boundary test uses Banks.
